nodes.description: cPLA2alpha catalyses the first step of the arachidonic acid cascade. Without it, stimulated cells cannot liberate arachidonic acid from membrane phospholipids, so cyclooxygenase and lipoxygenase products fall together. The defect is upstream of the cyclooxygenases: patient platelets aggregate normally when arachidonic acid is supplied directly.
